in_sanskrit.name: Agem
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Born from fire
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Agem एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Agem is derived from the Sanskrit word 'agni' which means fire. In Hindu mythology, Agni is the god of fire, and this name is believed to signify one who is born from fire or has a fiery spirit. It is a powerful and auspicious name.
